output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-75c73d9f8bd7] is just a metric name, but its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] states the change clearly. Metrics in this list that started with `cortex_` change to start with `loki_` in this release. You can keep the old prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is the metric `cortex_ruler_managers_total`; the change is a rename to `loki_ruler_managers_total`; environments are exposed when `metrics_namespace` is left at the default rather than set to `cortex`; and the consequence is that anything querying the old metric name stops matching.
